commits.author: dlwh
commits.message:
Update Pillow, virtualenv and filelock for security fixes (#10627)

Raise the workspace security floors to Pillow 13.0.0 and virtualenv
21.14.10, and move Levanter's filelock requirement to >=4.2.1,<5. Pillow
fixes the [FPX JPEG
overflow](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5x8w-8jj5-q52h) and
[lossless-JPEG thumbnail/draft
overflow](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8g5g-8vmr-9782); virtualenv
fixes [POSIX launcher
quoting](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c978-59m8-c77v) and
[temporary seed-cache
lifetime](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4f8h-vr72-p32c); filelock
fixes [SQLite read/write-lock path
handling](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v4x8-3wr5-3wq8). Preserve
unrelated lock records. Distlib 0.4.3, packaging 26.3 and
python-discovery 1.6.1 are the minimum companion versions satisfying
virtualenv's declared floors.

Virtualenv 21.14.8 was confirmed vulnerable; 21.14.9 fixes launcher
quoting, while 21.14.10 also fixes dangling seed-package links after
temporary-cache cleanup. Existing generated environments are untouched
and are not repaired by upgrading virtualenv alone. A later independent
pip install or upgrade can rewrite launcher wrappers, so trusted
destination paths remain necessary.

The FPX path requires olefile, which is absent from the root lock; the
separate lossless-JPEG issue has no such prerequisite. Deployment
exposure is unverified. Filelock's 4.x SoftReadWriteLock protocol is
incompatible with older participants on a shared lock path; repository
callers use ordinary FileLock, and no SoftReadWriteLock callers were
found. No running processes or lock directories were changed.

The lock check, required pre-commit checks, advisory review, 112
upstream Pillow tests, 492 filelock tests and 31 virtualenv
launcher/cache tests passed. Targeted pip-audit reports no known
vulnerabilities in the six changed packages. The broad root suite could
not collect locally because pytest-xdist is missing; CI at
14bc39ab2d3417a47193f7d0cd4a016a19780de8 finished with 43 passed checks,
14 skipped and none failed or pending.

commits.author: Helw150
commits.message:
[harbor] Install Mini-SWE adapter dependencies in the sandbox (#10631)

Install the OpenAI, HTTPX, and Tenacity dependencies used by the
Mini-SWE model adapter in its isolated tool environment. SWE-bench
trials currently fail before generation with `ModuleNotFoundError: No
module named 'httpx'`, and the resulting nonzero exit is counted as a
model failure.

Check the adapter import during setup so missing dependencies fail
before the agent runs.

commits.author: ravwojdyla-agent
commits.message:
[taskforge] Agentic Taskforge: build programs, varied answers, bubblewrap solvers (#10621)

* part of #9638
* agentic taskforge keeps the build program of each accepted task, so a
caller can make more instances of it, and can solve tasks in bubblewrap
* `submit` also takes the build program and, after the other checks and
before the review, checks that it writes the task again and that 8 other
ids give runnable tasks whose reference answers vary [^1]
* `taskforge.agentic.instances.task_instances` runs the program again on
the workspace snapshot of an accepted task
* `AgenticConfig.solver_factory`, `--solver-backend local`: solver
rollouts in bubblewrap; a task with a shell then sets
`command_semantics=linux_process` and installs its python with
`PackageSpec.pypi_packages`, and the prompt and the example program
describe the selected machine
* `generate_tasks_agentic.workspace_factory` also mounts the base
interpreter (`interpreter_mounts`), so `python3` in the sandbox is the
environment's interpreter on nodes where uv names its minor-version link
in `pyvenv.cfg`
* first of a stack for the rsi loop: this, #10622 (SkyRL task feed),
#9626 (loop), #10623 (evaluation)

[^1]: with qwen3-1.7b one accepted family had the reference answers 3, 4
or 5, and the policy learned to answer a guess without the work (0.06
against 0.51 for the control on that family's probes)

---------

commits.author: Helw150
commits.message:
[inference] Keep auxiliary requests out of the generation queue (#10551)

Forward model-info, metrics, and tokenization requests directly to
workers so long generations cannot block them in the broker queue.

Only workers with live heartbeat leases receive these requests. After
preemption, the replacement worker registers its new address. On a
connection failure or timeout, the proxy can try another ready worker
within the original request deadline.

---------

Co-authored-by: loom <claude-max-1@openathena.ai>

commits.author: dlwh
commits.message:
[levanter] Fix standalone GPU Torch runtime dependencies (#9657)

Standalone Levanter GPU jobs failed while importing Torch with
`ImportError: libcufile.so.0`. Declare Torch and its CUDA 12.8 source in
Levanter's GPU extra so uv includes the runtime dependencies when
Marin's GPU extra is absent.

The regenerated lock changes extra-selection markers without adding or
upgrading packages. Earlier GPU validation passed four paged-attention
parity cases and tiny Snowball generation on H100 and GB200. GB200 used
focused pytest dependencies because the broad test group includes an
ARM-incompatible torchcodec wheel.

Part of #7219.
